about: CI regression gate of design §17 (bench/check-regression.ps1): per CPU model of the CI runners, each case's ratio to a plain call in the same run. A case more than `tolerance` slower fails the build. Update an entry only with a reason in the pull request (a deliberate cost, or a new runner image).
